name: Seraphyne
source:
Mother of [url=https://vndb.org/c165577]Seraphion[/url] and a Queen of the Horde and former Queen of the Host. Seraphyne was seduced by [url=https://vndb.org/c165575]Xal'Zorrak[/url], King of the Horde. Xal pushed Seraphyne in to extreme debauchery leading her to transform into a demon lost to perversion.
